entries.name: Official Minecraft Wiki
entries.description: Minecraft Wiki is a complete resource for Minecraft, including gameplay, blocks, crafting, updates, events, mods, running a server, and resource packs.

entries.name: Chinese Minecraft Wiki
entries.description: The Chinese Minecraft Wiki is an official wiki of Minecraft, covering detailed tutorials on crafting, blocks, creatures and even PE versions.

entries.name: MinecraftSearch
entries.description: MinecraftSearch is an unofficial Minecraft Wiki with better user navigation that focuses on crafting, enchanting, villager trades, loot tables and a lot more.

entries.name: wiki.vg
entries.description: Technical Minecraft wiki.

entries.name: Minecraft Forums
entries.description: Official community forums, a great place to talk about the game.

entries.name: Planet Minecraft
entries.description: Creative community fansite.

entries.name: MCDOC
entries.description: The Index of Minecraft Tools and Unlockers

entries.name: Modrinth
entries.description: Open source Minecraft mod library with powerful filtering.

entries.name: CurseForge
entries.description: The largest repository for Minecraft mods.

entries.name: MCModArchive
entries.description: Archives old, lost and forgotten Minecraft mods and related software. Various other mods and stuff can be found on the MCArchive Discord.

entries.name: Minecraft Archive Project
entries.description: Huge archive containing Minecraft mods, worlds, resource packs and many other resources (even forum posts!).

entries.name: Eimer Archive
entries.description: Archive with a focus on server software and plugins.

entries.name: CraftBukkit Archive
entries.description: Archives many CraftBukkit versions.

entries.name: OmniArchive
entries.description: Archives most Minecraft jars.

entries.name: MCVersions
entries.description: Archives various Minecraft jars.

entries.name: Minecraft Forge
entries.description: Modifications to the Minecraft base files to assist in compatibility between mods.

entries.name: Quilt
entries.description: A powerful fork of the Fabric project.

entries.name: Fabric
entries.description: A lightweight, experimental modding toolchain for Minecraft.

entries.name: liteloader
entries.description: A lightweight mod loader for Minecraft designed to provide simple, high-performance and reliable loader functionality for mods which don't need to modify game mechanics.

entries.name: Rift
entries.description: A Mod Loader for 1.13-1.13.2 (even Snapshots).

entries.name: Meddle
entries.description: Everything related to modding 1.9/1.10 snapshots in one place.

entries.name: RopeMC
entries.description: A lightweight, reflection based mod loader which aims to be user friendly and later version independent.

entries.name: Optifine
entries.description: OptiFine is a Minecraft optimization mod.

entries.name: BetterFps
entries.description: BetterFps is a Minecraft mod that add a few performance improvements.

entries.name: Sodium (for Fabric)
entries.description: A Fabric mod designed to improve frame rates and reduce micro-stutter.

entries.name: OptiFabric
entries.description: A Fabric mod to allow Optifine to run using Fabric loader.

entries.name: Custom Skin Loader
entries.description: Custom Skin Loader for Minecraft.

entries.name: Universal Skin Mod
entries.description: A Minecraft Forge Mod allows players load custom skin & cape textures.

entries.name: Journey Map
entries.description: Real-time mapping in game or in a web browser as you explore.

entries.name: VoxelMap
entries.description: Formerly known as Zan's Minimap, providing basic map and radar functionality.

entries.name: Just Enough Items (JEI)
entries.description: JEI is an item and recipe viewing mod for Minecraft, built from the ground up for stability and performance.

entries.name: Bibliocraft
entries.description: Bibliocraft is a storage and organizational mod that began as a single bookcase and has expanded to so much more.

entries.name: /dank/null
entries.description: A storage mod of unreal proportions which nobody really gets. The max tier /dank/null object holds 54 slots of items which each can hold 2.14 billion items!

entries.name: Tinkers Construct
entries.description: Tinkers' Construct is a mod about putting tools together in a wide variety of ways, then modifying them until they turn into something else.

entries.name: Immersive Engineering
entries.description: Immersive Engineering is a tech mod with a certain charm, based on the ideas and concepts, and with most assets created by Damien Hazard.

entries.name: Botania
entries.description: Botania is a tech mod in essence. The theme is natural magic.

entries.name: Thermal Foundation + Dynamics + Expansion
entries.description: A server-friendly and content-rich blend of magic and technology! Title is three different mod names, but of the same series and usually played together.

entries.name: Railcraft
entries.description: Greatly expand and improve the Minecart system in Minecraft.

entries.name: Actually Additions
entries.description: Actually Additions is a technology mod that adds various utilities like multitools, item magnets, atomic reconstructors and so on.

entries.name: Applied Energistics 2
entries.description: A Minecraft Mod about Matter, Energy and using them to conquer the world. Mainly focused on item storage.

entries.name: Draconic Evolution
entries.description: One of the best tech mod there is, but really overpowered in the late game. Adds things like a Draconic Power Core which no one has been able to fill yet...

entries.name: Ender IO
entries.description: A large ender themed mod, that just adds lots of new fun things.

entries.name: Galacticraft
entries.description: A mod that adds rockets and new planets to explore. Expandable with addons.

entries.name: OpenComputers
entries.description: OpenComputers is a mod that adds computers and robots into the game, which can be programmed in Lua 5.3.

entries.name: ComputerCraft
entries.description: Adds computers based on Lua (5.2 and 5.3) into Minecraft.

entries.name: WarpDrive
entries.description: Adds Star Trek and other franchise like ships, weapons, transporters and so on into the game. Also adds new planets (dimensions).

entries.name: Pam's HarvestCraft
entries.description: Pam's HarvestCraft is a mod for Minecraft that currently adds many kinds of crops and food.

entries.name: AgriCraft
entries.description: A mod that adds a more sophisticated crop system, like the ability to have genetic mutations and also adds more crops.

entries.name: Bonsai Trees
entries.description: Adds essentially mini tree farms which are one block big.

entries.name: Ex Nihilo: Creatio
entries.description: A great mod for skyblocks, it filters things like sand and gravel for useful resources like iron and diamond, compatible with lots of mods.

entries.name: RFTools
entries.description: RFTools is a mod containing various tools that are related to RF (Redflux) or technology in general.

entries.name: Extreme Reactors
entries.description: Adds nuclear reactors with the fictional fuel 'yellorium'. A carry on of the original Big Reactors.

entries.name: Zetta Industries
entries.description: A mod which adds the main multiblock of a big battery.

entries.name: AbyssalCraft
entries.description: AbyssalCraft is a magic mod centered around exploration.

entries.name: Astral Sorcery
entries.description: This is a magic mod based on the stars, and harnessing the powers of starlight and the constellations.

entries.name: Avaritia
entries.description: Avaritia is a mod with a really long progression tree, but really overpowered in the late game. Its soul purpose is to drag the endgame gameplay to extreme lengths.

entries.name: Blood Magic
entries.description: This is a magic mod based on blood. Beware, you die a lot.

entries.name: TNTUtils
entries.description: More control over explosions in Minecraft.

entries.name: Akashic Tome
entries.description: A mod based on Morph-o-Tool, which mainly gives the ability to merge different mods' documentation books.

entries.name: AppleSkin
entries.description: This mod does not change any existing mechanics, but simply makes the existing hunger saturation and exhaustion levels visible in the default GUI.

entries.name: Attribute Fixer
entries.description: This mod fixes the attribute system in Minecraft which handles things like armour points, because many other mods are inadvertantly affected by a limit in this system.

entries.name: Diet Hopper
entries.description: This mod modifies the way Minecraft calculates the collision boxes of the hopper, so that you can access any visible blocks behind it.

entries.name: FoamFix
entries.description: Fixes various aspects of the Minecraft code, generally making the game faster.

entries.name: WTHIT
entries.description: Shows the block currently looked at (Newer version of Hwyla).

entries.name: Hwyla
entries.description: Shows the block currently looked at (Newer version of Waila).

entries.name: WorldInfo
entries.description: Shows the block currently looked at (Waila for Rift).

entries.name: Waila
entries.description: Shows the block currently looked at (The original Waila project).

entries.name: Block Helper
entries.description: Shows the block currently looked at (Legacy alternative of Waila for older Minecraft versions than 1.6).

entries.name: ArmorPlus
entries.description: This mod literally adds tons of armors to the game, and different ways of crafting them.

entries.name: Baubles
entries.description: This mod adds seven new slots to the player inventory which can be fitted with various items like amulets, belts, rings and so on added by other mods.

entries.name: Aroma1997's Dimensional World
entries.description: This mod adds one extra dimension, with the intended purpose of mining, meaning the Overworld will not be filled up with things like Buildcraft quarry holes anymore etc.

entries.name: Twilight Forest
entries.description: Adds a new twilight forest dimension with new sturctures, bosses, and quests to complete.

entries.name: Carpenter's Blocks
entries.description: This mod adds new blocks such as slants and corners which can be made to look like any other block in the game! Extremely useful for artistic builds. (For 1.12+ see BlockCraftery)

entries.name: Chisel
entries.description: This mod adds multiple new textures to lots of blocks in the game, adding a wide variety of textures. (For editing units smaller than blocks see Chisel and Bits.)

entries.name: WorldEdit
entries.description: WorldEdit is an open source in-game map editor available for Bukkit, Forge, MinecraftEdu, and many other platforms.

entries.name: FAWE
entries.description: Stands for Fast Async WorldEdit. Based upon WorldEdit, it is simply faster, and adds lots more tools (i.e. brushes) to work with.

entries.name: AntiCheatReloaded
entries.description: AntiCheatReloaded helps server admins easily identify and block malicious users by monitoring and analyzing the behaviour of their players.

entries.name: ViaVersion
entries.description: Allows the connection of newer clients to older server versions for Minecraft servers.

entries.name: AdvancedKitsReloaded
entries.description: AdvancedKitsReloaded is a Kit managing plugin for Minecraft servers which runs Bukkit, CraftBukkit, Spigot and Paper (>1.8). With this plugin you can easily create/edit/delete your kits and you can customize it as much as you'd like.

entries.name: WorldGuard
entries.description: WorldGuard lets you and players guard areas of land against griefers and undesirables, as well as tweak and disable various gameplay features of Minecraft.

entries.name: CraftBook
entries.description: CraftBook lets you create magically extending bridges, compact Redstone circuits, complex Minecart mechanics, and much more — all without a client mod and fully customizable by the server.

entries.name: Connect
entries.description: Open shared Minecraft network for advertising public and local host servers.

entries.name: LuckPerms
entries.description: Manage permissions.

entries.name: CoreProtect
entries.description: Log everything your players do. Literally 1984.

entries.name: BDCraft
entries.description: Various comic-style resource and sound packs, even for many mods, Bedrock Edition, and Terraria!

entries.name: LB Photo Realism Reload
entries.description: Successor of the LB Photo Realism texture pack making Minecraft look more realistic.

entries.name: Default Dark Mode
entries.description: Dark Mode for the default Minecraft UIs!

entries.name: Cyber Optics
entries.description: Sci-Fi resource pack.

entries.name: Soartex
entries.description: Smooth resource pack with mod support.

entries.name: BetterVanillaBuilding
entries.description: Adds loads of new blocks with connected textures in optifine.

entries.name: Continuum
entries.description: A realistic shader pack.

entries.name: Chocapic13
entries.description: A realistic and configurable shader pack.

entries.name: Sonic Ether
entries.description: Pathracing and other realistic shader packs.

entries.name: Sildur
entries.description: Shader packs even implementing Minecraft 1.16's built-in API.

entries.name: Potato
entries.description: A very lightweight shader pack for older or restrained PCs.

entries.name: ESBE 2G
entries.description: A shader pack for Bedrock Edition.

entries.name: White Wolf Shader
entries.description: Shader pack for Bedrock Edition focused on improving your gameplay experience.

entries.name: Blessing Skin Server
entries.description: A web application brings your custom skins back in offline Minecraft servers.

entries.name: WorldEdit Golf
entries.description: Challenge others in a competition to use WorldEdit in as few commands as possible.

entries.name: Cauldron
entries.description: Formerly known as MCPC+. The original server implementing the Forge and Bukkit API.

entries.name: Cloudburst/NukkitX/Nukkit
entries.description: A Bedrock Edition Server providing support for plugins supporting the Nukkit API.

entries.name: Docker-Minecraft
entries.description: A self-hosted Minecraft server using Docker containers.

entries.name: Glowstone
entries.description: Formerly known as Spout and BukkitContrib. Spigot Server alternative written from scratch with performance similar to Paper.

entries.name: KCauldron
entries.description: A server implementing the Forge and Bukkit API for 1.7.10.

entries.name: Legendary-Java-Minecraft-Geyser-Floodgate
entries.description: PaperMC server with out of the box Geyser and Floodgate support using docker.

entries.name: minecraft-docker
entries.description: Fork of Legendary-Java-Minecraft-Geyser-Floodgate that embeds a discord bot for easy starting and stopping of the server.

entries.name: Minestom
entries.description: Lightweight from-scratch server implementation.

entries.name: Mohist
entries.description: A server implementing the Forge and Bukkit API.

entries.name: Paper
entries.description: Miscellaneous patches for Spigot and BungeeCord providing better performance and more configuration options.

entries.name: Spigot
entries.description: CraftBukkit's successor providing support for the Bukkit API.

entries.name: Sponge
entries.description: Minecraft Server providing support for the Sponge API and is extensible to the Forge API and Bukkit API.

entries.name: Thermos
entries.description: A server implementing the Forge and Bukkit API for 1.7.10.

entries.name: Gate
entries.description: A high performance & paralleled Minecraft proxy written in Go.

entries.name: CraftLib
entries.description: Complete Kotlin / Java library for wrapping the entire Minecraft codebase, including protocol, NBT, schematics, chat and more.

entries.name: MCProtocolLib
entries.description: A simple library for communicating with a Minecraft client/server, written in Java.

entries.name: node-minecraft-protocol
entries.description: A NodeJS library to parse and serialize minecraft packets, plus authentication and encryption.

entries.name: go-mcproto
entries.description: Minecraft server communication protocol implementation written in Go that allows you to program your own bots.

entries.name: Minecraft Command Helper
entries.description: A WPF Program about generate Minecraft Command (with NBT data). (Windows Only)

entries.name: Minecraft Command Science
entries.description: Several Minecraft vanilla JSON generators.

entries.name: Amidst
entries.description: Display an overview of a Minecraft world, without actually creating it.

entries.name: Amulet
entries.description: Map viewer/editor.

entries.name: NBTEditor
entries.description: Edit NBT from .dat files.

entries.name: MultiMC
entries.description: A custom launcher for Minecraft that allows you to easily manage multiple installations of Minecraft at once.

entries.name: Prism
entries.description: A fork of MultiMC, capable of downloading modpacks and other resources directly from CurseForge and FTB.

entries.name: HMCL
entries.description: A powered Minecraft launcher that supports a lot of features.

entries.name: XMCL
entries.description: X Minecraft Launcher (XMCL) is a modern Minecraft launcher that lets you manage your massive resources like modpacks, resource packs, mods and shader packs.

entries.name: Polymerium
entries.description: 🐿️ A next-generation Minecraft instance manager that thinks differently about game management.

entries.name: FML Mod Development Tutorial
entries.description: (Chinese) Minecraft 1.8.9 FML Mod Development Tutorial.

entries.name: SchematicWebViewer
entries.description: A JavaScript/TypeScript library for rendering and viewing Minecraft schematic files on the web.

entries.name: Tabula
entries.description: Minecraft Mod that faciliates creating 3D Models.

entries.name: Mod Coder Pack
entries.description: Tool for properly decompiling Minecraft.

entries.name: BON 2
entries.description: A rewrite of the Bearded Octo Nemesis project with support for ForgeGradle.

entries.name: Bearded Octo Nemesis
entries.description: Tool for deobfuscating with support for SRG mappings and especially the Mod Coder Pack.
